dedupe_keys.name: mtn consulting energy and sustainability tracker telcos 2025

description: The MTN Consulting Energy and Sustainability Tracker is a commercial report on energy use, renewable use and emissions in the telecommunications industry. Contents: an assessment of 66 telcos representing about 85 percent of the global market, with metrics on usage and efficiency; the page states that telcos consumed 340.6 TWh (340,572 GWh) in 2024, more than double the webscale operators, that telco energy use flatlined in 2024 while greenhouse gas emissions fell again due to renewables and scope 3 efforts, and that telcos spend on average 4 to 5 percent of operating expenses on energy, some over 10 percent. Producer: MTN Consulting, published on 27 November 2025 (report ID GNI-28112025-1) as a joint study with Téral Research. Coverage: global, by operator. Access: sold as a report, with a sample file and login on the product page. Licence and cost: paid; pricing not read. Caveats: the data tables sit behind the paywall, so only the headline figures are visible, and the operator sample excludes smaller telcos. Simulation uses: operator energy and emissions baselines for telecom energy demand, decarbonisation and climate-risk models. Related record: ITU ICT statistics (data-itu-ict-statistics) for the wider sector indicators.
